description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe smiling on the roof of her portal at Ghost Ranch with with a young woman named Bernie in a flowered dress and  a baby, Little Max who is between them; O'Keeffe is squatting  dressed in a collared long sleeve shirt and jeans with her hair pulled back in a pony tail. Bernie and O'Keeffe hold the baby up behind the big cow skull  which is suspended between the two vigas on the facade of the portal; a blank sky is behind them.
title: Bernie, Little Max, and Georgia O'Keeffe
